title: Cache Line Buffer
statement: Create a simple 4-line cache buffer that stores 16-bit tag/data pairs and supplies data on hits. The module should check tags for a hit and output valid data only on hits. A miss is indicated by valid being low.
module_signature: module cache_line_buffer(input clk, input rst, input [1:0] index, input [7:0] tag, input [15:0] data_in, input write_en, output reg [15:0] data_out, output reg hit);
behavior: hit is 1 when the requested tag matches the stored tag at index.
data_out holds valid data only on a hit.
All state updates occur on the rising edge of clk.
rst is active-high and synchronous unless the problem statement explicitly says otherwise.
Use non-blocking assignments in clocked always blocks.
Outputs must never depend on uninitialized x/z state after reset.
When rst is asserted on a rising edge, registered outputs reset to their documented initial values.
constraints: Do not use built-in cache or associative memory primitives.
example:
index tag write_en | hit data_out
00 00000001 0 | 0 xxxx
01 00000010 1 | 0 data
hint: Store separate tag and data arrays with enable control.
